atom_reviews.question: Are there any rabbits in the image?
atom_reviews.expert_evidence: fine_grained_classifier top prediction: 'wood rabbit' (logit 7.33), 'hare' (logit 7.04). Taxonomy checkpoints for hare (massively elongated hind limbs, muscular thighs) are absent; subjects match cottontail rabbit morphology more closely.
atom_reviews.reasoning: Rabbits are clearly present and identifiable. However, taxonomy conformance is reduced because the specific diagnostic features for the 'hare' class described in the taxonomy (elongated hind legs, massive thighs) are missing. Subjects appear as standard rabbits rather than hares, warranting partial tax_score penalty.

authenticity_review: Significant AI artifacts undermine authenticity despite strong initial visual appeal. All four subjects share identical unnatural bright blue eyes with uniform highlights - clear texture copying/hallucination. Visible fusion between central rabbits where fur boundaries blur indistinctly. Paws and lower legs lack anatomical definition, merging into grass texture (structural collapse). These compound defects substantially reduce authenticity score.
key_defects: Unnatural identical blue eyes across all subjects
Fusion/blending of fur between central rabbits
Indistinct paws merging with grass texture
Missing hare-specific anatomy (massively elongated hind limbs)
